mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but FEDFUNDS does not rise > 25bp in the next 3 months, or SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 5pp but CPI inflation does not rise > 0.5pp in the next 6 months, or SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, defined as an increase of > 50bp in 3 months, signals a tightening monetary cycle that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises > 50bp in 3 months but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the housing starts index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth drops by > 10pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating increase in payroll employment, as measured by the 3-month change in the PAYEMS series, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month change in PAYEMS accelerates by > 100k jobs/mo but SPX 20-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid deceleration in the rate of change of the consumer price index, as measured by the 3-month change in CPIAUCSL, signals a disinflationary regime shift that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month change in CPIAUCSL decelerates by > 1pp but SPX 60-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real estate investment, as measured by the year-over-year change in the RSAFS series, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y RSAFS growth drops by > 10pp but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.
